messages.subject: Corporate & Competition team dinner — date poll
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

We're overdue a team dinner. I've put a poll on the intranet with three options in the last week of March. Please vote by Friday. Thinking somewhere near Liverpool Street so it's easy after work. Let me know dietary requirements.

Donna
